old_behaviour: SET table silently removes exact duplicate rows. Seeded staging has 300 rows, 250 distinct; source has 250. runner.py enforces UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT plus ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING.
new_behaviour: SELECT DISTINCT drops exact duplicates to match Teradata SET semantics (300 to 250). Billing and audit consume the deduped core table.
confirmation: Finance still has to confirm the invoice impact.

old_behaviour: ROW_NUMBER partitions by DOCUMENT_ID and sorts only VERSION_TS DESC. Fifty seeded documents have two distinct versions at the same latest timestamp; winner is unspecified.
new_behaviour: Owner-approved: highest VERSION_NO wins tied latest VERSION_TS. Deliberately differs from legacy arbitrary selection.

old_behaviour: XML lookup policy is Use First Value. For multiple role grants per USER_ID the runner selects the first cached match.
new_behaviour: Owner-approved: highest privilege wins, ADMIN then EDITOR then other roles; no role leaves the source access unchanged. Deliberately differs from legacy first cached match.
